text: Hey mon onon ɗoo, hiɗon noddee e fii wintagol seeɗa e jawle mon ɗen, fii laawol Allah ngol, wanaa jawle mon ɗen fow ɗaɓɓiraɗon e ɗum. Hino e mo'on non, salorayɓe ɗum nguddam. Kala non wuddirɗo seeɗa e jawdi muin ndin fii laawol Allah ngol, haray ko hoore-makko o añani baraaji wintagol ngol. Ko Allah woni Galo Mo hatonjinaa e ko wintotoɗon, Onon kan wonɗon waasuɓe hatonjimɓe e Makko. Si on yiltike e lislaamu on haa on jokkoyii keeferaaku ngun, O gaynay fii mooɗon, O addoyay woɗɓe goo, hara non ɓen wa'oytaa wano mon, ɓen ko ɗoftoytooɓe Mo wonata.
